title: Commit
description: One entry in scenario/commit_history.json. Synthetic git-style commit log, scoped to this scenario only — not general git blame.

diff.description: Unified-diff-style text snippet of the change made in this commit

is_introducing_commit.description: True for exactly one commit in the history: the one that added the allUsers binding. Explicit flag kept alongside the diff so git_history_tools.py doesn't need diff-parsing heuristics on Day 1 — it can trust this field directly, then optionally cross-check it against the diff text.
